card.name: Kor/Ko starts of surnames; Estimated in trial tables
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the start of rare surnames beginning with K (Kor, K, Ko), mostly in author lists and citations. It also responds to the word Estimated in trial-record tables before Primary Completion Date.

modes.label: Surname starts
modes.description: The first piece of an uncommon K-surname, split before the rest of the name, in author or citation text.

modes.label: Trial date tables
modes.description: The word Estimated, or the table divider after a date, in clinical trial records.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it promotes odd word pieces like 'reek' and 'ght' and suppresses unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letters of unusual K-surnames in citations, and on 'Estimated' in trial date tables.
